description: This file defines functions to generate and sanitize an OpenAPI/Swagger specification for an Express application, including loading a prebuilt spec, falling back to JSDoc annotations, and ensuring the spec's validity.

methods.name: buildCommonComponents
methods.description: Builds reusable components such as parameters and schemas for the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Creates a Swagger spec from JSDoc annotations as a fallback.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes an OpenAPI document by fixing paths, ensuring required fields, and injecting common components.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main function to retrieve the base OpenAPI specification, loading from file or generating via JSDoc.
